# GDG Web Dev Recruitment Portal (Full Documentation)

This is a modern, fast, and feature-rich recruitment portal built for smooth onboarding and easy management.

**Live App:** [https://gdg-webdev.vercel.app/](https://gdg-webdev.vercel.app/)

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 14 (App Router)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS, class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge
- **Authentication**: Better Auth (with Firestore Adapter)
- **Database**: Firebase / Firestore
- **UI Components**: Radix UI Primitives, shadcn-inspired components
- **Animations**: Framer Motion, GSAP, OGL
- **Forms**: React Hook Form + Zod
- **Rich Text**: Tiptap Editor
- **Icons**: Lucide React, Material Symbols, React Icons
- **Other**: React Table, React CSV, Nodemailer

## Core Features & Architecture
- **`/app/(pages)/admin`**: Centralized dashboard to control all aspects of the recruitment portal. Manage users, applications, and portal states.
- **`/app/(pages)/join`**: Interactive onboarding and application flow.
- **`/app/(pages)/departments`**: Detailed overviews of different departments.
- **`/app/(pages)/development`**: Development and progress showcase.
- **`/components`**: Reusable modular UI components.
- **`/lib`**: Helper utilities and configuration.

## LLM Integration Context
This application exposes AI-friendly endpoints (`llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt`) in the public folder to facilitate easy parsing and understanding of the app's structure and tech stack by external agents.
